name: Pre-G synthesis C
identityStatus: PFD-listed tag/group mapped to modeled equipment identity

design.materialOfConstruction: Glass-lined carbon steel; glass-lined agitator and wetted internals

operatingEnvelope.graphitePerBatchKg: 500 (batch sizes of PFD V5.1.1); 2.3 batches/day nominal, 3.0 design; two operating reactors plus one spare on the 9–10 h cycle of REP-040
operatingEnvelope.worstCaseAdiabaticRiseK: +54 K to ≈ 135 °C if the whole reactive inventory releases at the 80 °C hold (P₂O₅ hydration ≈ 400 MJ computable; persulfate oxidation 90–420 MJ unmeasured — calorimetry required, F-06); no vapour-pressure runaway, hazards are chemical (persulfate decomposition → O₂, Caro's acid)
operatingEnvelope.p2o5DosingStrategy: Dose P₂O₅ during heat-up so its 400 MJ supplies ≈ 45 % of the 887 MJ heat-up duty and halves heat-up time on the 95 °C loop (≈ 1 h)
operatingEnvelope.transferTemperatureC: Transfer hot (80 °C) to T-161 rather than cooling to 10–20 °C — deletes the R-141 cool-down and the chilled-water need; sensible heat 0.9 GJ is 14 % of the T-161 dilution heat
operatingEnvelope.utilityBasis: HWS 95 °C; cooling water 25–30 °C; chilled water 5–7 °C (A-5000) — CHW needed only for the cool-down leg this report removes

reviewFindings: Approved R-141A/B/C/D datasheets and working volumes are unavailable.
